transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora, and I've just completed your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. 

Do you have any questions about your surgery or your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora! Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Great question! You can start doing light exercise like gardening about 1 week after your surgery. However, you should avoid any strenuous or heavy exercise for about a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for the information! My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a good question. If you were using eye gel for dry eyes before your operation, it's safe to continue using it unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

If you're unsure about the specific timing or have any concerns, I'd recommend checking with your care team.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, that's helpful to know. Another thing I've noticed is that I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Yes, that's quite common! It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to your new lenses. 

If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside. However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light or your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to check it further.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It's common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after surgery, and it should improve quickly and settle down over time.

How long ago was your surgery? If your vision is still blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything's okay.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's great to hear! Just to confirm - have all your questions been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered. Thanks again for your assistance!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome! Take care and best wishes with your recovery.
